final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: diode sinks the 10uA reference
MREF  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=1.8 L=0.5 m=1
* tail current source, 24x -> ~240uA
MTAIL tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=1.8 L=0.5 m=24
* NMOS input pair (vinp on diode side -> non-inverting)
MIN_P n1    vinp  tail vss nfet W=7 L=1 m=10
MIN_N vout  vinn  tail vss nfet W=7 L=1 m=10
* PMOS current-mirror load
MLD1  n1    n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=5 L=0.6 m=10
MLD2  vout  n1    vdd  vdd pfet W=5 L=0.6 m=10
.ends
